name: NASA Blue Marble: Next Generation - July 2004 with Topography
producer: Reto Stöckli, NASA Earth Observatory (NASA Goddard Space Flight Center)
usage: NASA informational imagery, generally not subject to U.S. copyright. Attribution is retained. No NASA insignia, promotion or endorsement is included. This source has no third-party copyright notice.
conversion: Equirectangular global image resized with Lanczos to 16384x8192, then successive 2x reductions for zoom levels 0-4; 682 JPEG tiles of 512x512. Globe texture 2048x1024 resized directly from source. JPEG quality 83, progressive, optimized, 4:4:4. No administrative boundary overlay.
